title: lagoseris intybacea
intro: Lagoseris intybacea, commonly known as the "Sand-rosemary" or "Wild rosemary", is a flowering plant that belongs to the family Asteraceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and fighting against infections due to its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory effects. The health benefits of Lagoseris intybacea include its ability to improve respiratory health, reduce fever, and alleviate symptoms of colds and flu. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which work together to exert its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties.
